2645-3430-3478-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3478-5475.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3263-3967-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-3967-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-3967-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

1339-1832-4050-7286.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-7286.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

813-1777-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
813-1777-8129.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Stitch Together from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3234-3293-6620-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-6620-8095.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-6620-8095.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5256-5662--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-1974.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-1974.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-1974.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

955-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
955-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
955-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2239-4377-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-719-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
413-719-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Blasting Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Repeat from step 5.

343-2366-5702-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-5702-6791.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1354-2757-4249-5094.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 7.
1354-2757-4249-5094.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G}
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {3}{G}{G}, creating a creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

198-1978-3301.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1978-3301.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

2478-2866-4050-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2092-5231-6873.description:
Activate Fire Nation Archers by paying {1}, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and creating a 2/2 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {R}.
Repeat

772-6553-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

222-527-997-3499.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-3499.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

567-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
567-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

643-907-1399-1606.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2239-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Ardent Elementalist each turn.
2239-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Ardent Elementalist from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1376-4091-4235.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-4091-4235.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Priest of Titania.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

1951-2534-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Speaker of the Heavens does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 47.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
1951-2534-4875.description:
Activate Speaker of the Heavens by tapping it, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token with flying.
When the Angel enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Speaker of the Heavens.
Repeat.

890-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Palladium Myr.
Palladium Myr does not have summoning sickness.
890-3263-3525.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Palladium Myr.
Repeat.

1651-1961-2073-4680.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature.
The creature dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Throne of Geth trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Salvaging Station and The Hollow Sentinel, untapping Throne of Geth.
Repeat.

404-1521-2105-4885.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-2105-4885.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

1168-1479-3257.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1168-1479-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Toggo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Toggo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1524-2724-3217.notablePrerequisites: Ilharg does not have summoning sickness.
1524-2724-3217.description:
Attack with Ilharg.
Ilharg's attack trigger triggers, putting Wormfang Manta onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Wormfang Manta is returned to your hand.
This triggers its LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.

2026-3525-3664.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
2026-3525-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.
